editorialSummary.heading: DFW and Brazos County breaks and student Data Days
highlights: DFW and Brazos County Spring Break: March 15–19
Fall Break: October 12–16, including two parent-conference days
170 instructional days across six grading cycles
paragraphs: International Leadership of Texas (ILTexas) lists March 15–19, 2027, as Spring Break for DFW and Brazos County schools. Houston-area campuses have March 8–12 instead. Each region has one week off, not both. The district notes that these dates may change to align with surrounding communities. DFW and Brazos County classes are scheduled to resume March 22.

September 21 and February 22 are Data Days marked as student holidays, with no regular classes. Fall Break is October 12–16; October 15–16 also have teacher PD and parent conferences. Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, and Winter Break runs December 18–January 6. Students remain off through January 6, even though some staff have professional-development activities during the final days. Classes resume January 7.

The calendar has six grading cycles and 170 instructional days. April 30 is a student holiday for teacher work. May 26 is the listed last day of school. The calendar also reserves March 26 and May 27 as possible weather make-up days, so families should check for schedule changes. Summer School is scheduled for June 1–15, 2027, for selected students only.

faqs.question: Which regional ILTexas calendar should I use for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Use this view for the DFW and Brazos County dates in the district PDF: Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027. Houston uses the separate March 8–12 view. These are regional groups, not a campus-by-campus list; confirm your school's assigned region if you are unsure.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for ILTexas in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Thursday, August 13, 2026, is the first day of school and the start of Cycle 1.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for ILTexas in 2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Wednesday, May 26, 2027, as the last day of school. May 27 is a Cycle 6 Data Day and an Inclement Weather Day, so check district announcements for any change to the end-of-year schedule.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are in the ILTexas 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: ILTexas lists 170 instructional days across six grading cycles: 26, 24 and 29 days in the first semester, then 31, 33 and 27 in the second. The separate 187 figure includes 17 professional-development days; it is not the student instructional-day total.

faqs.question: Do ILTexas students have school on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is the Labor Day Holiday. Classes resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Is September 21, 2026, a school day?
faqs.answer: No. September 21 is the Cycle 1 Data Day and a student holiday. Cycle 2 begins Tuesday, September 22.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas Fall Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break for Students is October 12–16. October 12–14 are student/teacher holidays; October 15–16 are student holidays with teacher professional development and parent conferences. Classes resume Monday, October 19.

faqs.question: When are ILTexas fall parent conferences in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists parent conferences and teacher professional development on October 15–16, during the student Fall Break. It does not give conference times; use your campus’s appointment instructions.

faqs.question: Does ILTexas have school on Election Day 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Regular classes are scheduled for Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The district calendar does not mark Election Day as a student holiday. Check your campus for any schedule updates.

faqs.question: Are ILTexas students off on Veterans Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is named Veterans Day, but the calendar does not mark it as a student holiday. It remains a regular student day on the published schedule.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23–27, 2026. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas Winter Break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 18, 2026, through January 6, 2027. Students return Thursday, January 7. December 17 is the last day of Cycle 3 and the first semester.

faqs.question: When do students return after Winter Break?
faqs.answer: Thursday, January 7, 2027. That day begins Cycle 4 and the second semester.

faqs.question: Do students attend school on January 4–6, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. DFW and Brazos County students remain on Winter Break through January 6. DFW staff have an Area-wide PD Conference January 4 and a Campus Data/PD Day January 5. The PDF does not assign those staff activities to Brazos County. January 6 is a Charterwide Teacher Work Day; students return January 7.

faqs.question: Are ILTexas students off for Martin Luther King Jr. Day 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, is labeled a Student/Teacher Holiday on the ILTexas calendar. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Do ILTexas students have school on Presidents’ Day 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. February 15 is not marked as a student holiday on this calendar. The February student holiday is Monday, February 22, for the Cycle 4 Data Day; classes resume February 23.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas DFW & Brazos County Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: DFW and Brazos County students have Spring Break March 15–19, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 22. ILTexas says the dates are subject to change to align with surrounding communities, so confirm any later campus update before making plans.

faqs.question: Does ILTexas have two weeks of Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Houston-area students use March 8–12, and DFW and Brazos County students use March 15–19. The two ranges in the shared calendar apply to different regions; they are not a two-week break for every student. The dates are subject to change to align with surrounding communities.

faqs.question: What does an ILTexas Data Day mean for students?
faqs.answer: The calendar labels September 21 and February 22 “Data Day (Student Holiday),” so students have no regular classes on those dates. May 27 is also a Cycle 6 Data Day, but it doubles as an Inclement Weather Day and may be affected by a weather-related schedule change.

faqs.question: Which Spring Break dates apply to ILTexas Liberty-area campuses?
faqs.answer: The ILTexas district calendar lists Spring Break for Houston-area schools as March 8–12, 2027, and for DFW and Brazos County schools as March 15–19. It does not specify which schedule applies to Liberty-area campuses. Check with your child's Liberty campus before making plans.

faqs.question: Which dates are ILTexas Inclement Weather Days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: March 26 and May 27, 2027, are reserved Inclement Weather Days. The published calendar shows no regular student classes on those dates, but they are not guaranteed holidays. May 27 is also a Cycle 6 Data Day; follow ILTexas announcements if weather requires a schedule change.

faqs.question: Does ILTexas have school on Good Friday 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled for Friday, March 26, 2027. ILTexas designates the date as Inclement Weather Day #1, not a Good Friday holiday. It may be used as a make-up day if weather-related schedule changes are needed.

faqs.question: Will students have classes on May 27, 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled for May 27 under the published calendar. The date is listed as Cycle 6 Data Day / Inclement Weather Day #2, so it could become a school day if ILTexas uses it for weather-related make-up classes.

faqs.question: Is April 30, 2027, a school day?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 30, is a student holiday and teacher workday. Classes resume Monday, May 3.

faqs.question: What are the ILTexas grading-cycle dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Cycle 1 runs August 13–September 18; Cycle 2, September 22–October 30; Cycle 3, November 2–December 17; Cycle 4, January 7–February 19; Cycle 5, February 23–April 16; and Cycle 6, April 19–May 26.

faqs.question: Are early-release days listed on the ILTexas 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: No early-release or half-day dates are listed on the district calendar. Check your campus calendar for any school-specific dismissal changes.

faqs.question: Where can I find ILTexas campus start and dismissal times?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not list daily start or dismissal times. Check your campus's bell schedule or contact the school for current hours.

faqs.question: When do senior exams end at ILTexas in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 14, is listed as the last day for senior exams. The calendar does not provide the full exam schedule, subjects or times, and this is not a graduation date.

faqs.question: When are ILTexas graduation ceremonies in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not list graduation ceremony dates, times or venues. Check your high school’s announcements for its 2027 ceremony schedule; May 14 is the senior-exam endpoint, not a graduation date.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas Summer School in 2027?
faqs.answer: Summer School is listed for June 1–15, 2027, for selected students. The marked weekday sessions are June 1–4, June 7–11 and June 14–15; the calendar does not show weekend sessions. Check campus instructions for the hours and dates assigned to your child.

faqs.question: Does every ILTexas student attend Summer School?
faqs.answer: No. The calendar says Summer School is for a select group of students, with all others on break. Campus instructions should explain who is assigned to attend and the program’s hours.

faqs.question: Where should families check for ILTexas weather closures?
faqs.answer: Use ILTexas’s Weather Resources page and your campus’s latest announcements. Closures can differ by region; a DFW closure does not automatically mean Houston or Brazos County campuses are closed.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official ILTexas 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The Board-approved PDF is linked from ILTexas’s Families calendar page. It was approved April 22, 2026, and includes both regional Spring Break schedules.

faqs.answer: Yes. February 15 is not marked as a student holiday on this calendar. The February student holiday is Monday, February 22, for the Cycle 4 Data Day; classes resume February 23.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas Houston Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Houston-area students have Spring Break March 8–12, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 15. ILTexas says the dates are subject to change to align with surrounding communities, so confirm any later campus update before making plans.

faqs.question: Does ILTexas have two weeks of Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Houston-area students use March 8–12, and DFW and Brazos County students use March 15–19. The two ranges in the shared calendar apply to different regions; they are not a two-week break for every student. The dates are subject to change to align with surrounding communities.

faqs.question: What does an ILTexas Data Day mean for students?
faqs.answer: The calendar labels September 21 and February 22 “Data Day (Student Holiday),” so students have no regular classes on those dates. May 27 is also a Cycle 6 Data Day, but it doubles as an Inclement Weather Day and may be affected by a weather-related schedule change.

faqs.question: Which Spring Break dates apply to ILTexas Liberty-area campuses?
faqs.answer: The ILTexas district calendar lists Spring Break for Houston-area schools as March 8–12, 2027, and for DFW and Brazos County schools as March 15–19. It does not specify which schedule applies to Liberty-area campuses. Check with your child's Liberty campus before making plans.

faqs.question: Which dates are ILTexas Inclement Weather Days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: March 26 and May 27, 2027, are reserved Inclement Weather Days. The published calendar shows no regular student classes on those dates, but they are not guaranteed holidays. May 27 is also a Cycle 6 Data Day; follow ILTexas announcements if weather requires a schedule change.

faqs.question: Does ILTexas have school on Good Friday 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled for Friday, March 26, 2027. ILTexas designates the date as Inclement Weather Day #1, not a Good Friday holiday. It may be used as a make-up day if weather-related schedule changes are needed.

faqs.question: Will students have classes on May 27, 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled for May 27 under the published calendar. The date is listed as Cycle 6 Data Day / Inclement Weather Day #2, so it could become a school day if ILTexas uses it for weather-related make-up classes.

faqs.question: Is April 30, 2027, a school day?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 30, is a student holiday and teacher workday. Classes resume Monday, May 3.

faqs.question: What are the ILTexas grading-cycle dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Cycle 1 runs August 13–September 18; Cycle 2, September 22–October 30; Cycle 3, November 2–December 17; Cycle 4, January 7–February 19; Cycle 5, February 23–April 16; and Cycle 6, April 19–May 26.

faqs.question: Are early-release days listed on the ILTexas 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: No early-release or half-day dates are listed on the district calendar. Check your campus calendar for any school-specific dismissal changes.

faqs.question: Where can I find ILTexas campus start and dismissal times?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not list daily start or dismissal times. Check your campus's bell schedule or contact the school for current hours.

faqs.question: When do senior exams end at ILTexas in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 14, is listed as the last day for senior exams. The calendar does not provide the full exam schedule, subjects or times, and this is not a graduation date.

faqs.question: When are ILTexas graduation ceremonies in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar does not list graduation ceremony dates, times or venues. Check your high school’s announcements for its 2027 ceremony schedule; May 14 is the senior-exam endpoint, not a graduation date.

faqs.question: When is ILTexas Summer School in 2027?
faqs.answer: Summer School is listed for June 1–15, 2027, for selected students. The marked weekday sessions are June 1–4, June 7–11 and June 14–15; the calendar does not show weekend sessions. Check campus instructions for the hours and dates assigned to your child.

faqs.question: Does every ILTexas student attend Summer School?
faqs.answer: No. The calendar says Summer School is for a select group of students, with all others on break. Campus instructions should explain who is assigned to attend and the program’s hours.

faqs.question: Where should families check for ILTexas weather closures?
faqs.answer: Use ILTexas’s Weather Resources page and your campus’s latest announcements. Closures can differ by region; a DFW closure does not automatically mean Houston or Brazos County campuses are closed.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official ILTexas 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The Board-approved PDF is linked from ILTexas’s Families calendar page. It was approved April 22, 2026, and includes both regional Spring Break schedules.
